scenario.title: Temporary branch and release previews
situations: Release reviewer needs a frozen candidate URL
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Scheduled expiry and branch-deletion recovery were read as Pack obligations, not exercised against a host.

lessons.title: Preview has real prerequisites
lessons.when: A browser review needs a temporary deployed target
lessons.need: Check ephemeral-env capability and serving support before offering a preview. The shipped Pack depends on host/routing/deploy Packs and application-specific configuration; it is not provider-neutral instant hosting.
lessons.surface: Onboard profile lines 55–56; Ephemeral Environments Pack introduction and project-specific work.
lessons.gap: Proposed JOURNEYS branch should offer a supported existing target or preview setup, with unsupported/deferred alternatives visible.

lessons.title: Branch preview differs from release evidence
lessons.when: Using a preview for QA or human release review
lessons.need: A branch preview changes on pushes. A release preview freezes a full candidate commit under a run-owned name; QA consumes the earlier preview receipt. Declare lifetime, data retention and cleanup ownership.
lessons.surface: Ephemeral Environments Pack release-preview section; preview producer registry.
lessons.gap: This distinction belongs in the short preview explanation before a URL is accepted as release evidence. Occupancy/teardown refusal must retain the frozen candidate instead of deleting it.
